question: Which deity is regarded as the worshipped name among all these names?
premises: Among all, this name is worshipped.
The deity Śrī Durgā is identified with it.
inference: Śrī Durgā is held to be the worshipped deity embodied in these names.
plain_english: Among all, this worshipped name is considered to be the deity Śrī Durgā.
